once {
  act: DisplayText("init")
}
once {
  cond: VarCmp(@var, AtLeast, 5)
  act: DisplayText("milestone")
}
when {
  cond: VarCmp(@var, AtLeast, 10)
  cond: VarCmp(@var, Exactly, 0)
  act: DisplayText("standing")
}
until {
  cond: VarCmp(@var, Exactly, 0)
  act: DisplayText("countdown")
}
after (24 loops) {
  act: DisplayText("delayed")
}
every (12 loops) {
  act: DisplayText("periodic")
}
